output.brief: The pipeline jump is not real buying activity, and the reps did not get worse at closing. Of the $6.5M increase, $6.2M came from 212 records loaded in one bulk import on 29 Sept, run under Sales Operations user j.okafor. None of them has any logged calls, emails or meetings. 171 of them match old closed-lost deals from 2024 with the same amounts and new Q4 close dates. The Brightwell partner portal shows only 3 registered deals worth $0.21M, and Brightwell sent no bulk list. Reps' own opportunities held steady: win rate about 24% each quarter, and the four named reps are within the normal range. The webinars produced 11 opportunities worth $0.46M. The $5.9M "influenced" figure is mostly the imported records. Rep-created pipeline gives about 1.9x coverage, below the 3.0x gate. I don't know who prepared the file. Wexley's 28 Sept email asked for deals to be logged but did not mention a bulk import, and she denies supplying a file. That is unproven either way. Next steps: don't start performance plans and don't release the requisitions. Quarantine the imported records and restate coverage. Preserve and examine the import file's metadata, the import job record and the chat channel. Interview Okafor and the channel members before blaming anyone. Hold off on the webinar expansion.
